verdict.rationale: Pulling campaign and flow metrics through an API is a fair question for an email marketing platform, so the axis applies. The pack never mentions a reporting or metrics API. The only analytics evidence is in-product custom dashboards (moosend-docs-7) and 'advanced data insights' (moosend-docs-11), which are adjacent features and give no programmatic export to a developer's own warehouse or dashboards.

support.subject: As a developer, I can pull campaign and flow performance metrics through the API into my own warehouse or dashboards
